Continue with the same referenced fictional Korean senior student in a classroom portrait, seated on a chair with one shoe-clad foot placed on the desk, that raised knee touching one cheek, and a direct gaze toward the camera.

Create a natural vertical classroom portrait of the same fictional 18-year-old Korean high-school senior shown in the attached reference image. She sits sideways on a wooden classroom chair beside a desk. One polished loafer rests flat on the desktop, bringing that bent knee close to her face, while her other shoe stays planted on the floor. She leans gently until one cheek rests in clear contact with the raised knee and looks directly into the camera with a quiet, intent expression. Her torso curls slightly around the knee; both hands loosely circle the raised shin, leaving the cheek-to-knee contact visible. Retain the reference's long straight dark hair, airy bangs, large brown eyes, soft pink lips, navy blazer, white shirt, plaid ribbon bow, dark pleated skirt, knee-high socks, and loafers. Frame her from head to both shoes in a vertical composition, with the elevated foot, bent knee, cheek contact, and grounded foot all readable at once. Use a clean green chalkboard, warm window light, realistic fabric folds, natural skin detail, and a calm after-class atmosphere.
